messages.en: There's a small mistake in the shift schedule. Your name was listed twice for Friday. I've fixed it—have another look.
Yeah, the updated one's right. Thanks! Otherwise, I really would've thought I had to work two shifts.

senses.en_definition: The feeling or state of being afraid; fear.
A feeling of awe or self-conscious reserve arising from respect for someone.

collocations.en: feeling inhibited around someone one respects

senses.en_definition: Anxiety or apprehension about what may happen.

messages.en: I'm so scared right now. I keep picturing the ghost from that movie we just watched. I don't even dare turn off my bedroom light.
See? You were acting so brave earlier 😂 Want me to keep you company and chat till you get sleepy?
Yes! But no more ghost stories.
This top's way too tight. I want to exchange it for a bigger size.
Go for it. Have you checked that shop's size guide?
I can't stop laughing at this video!
I've watched it three times and it still makes me laugh!
